# Manager

Qualified name: `manim.manager.Manager`

class Manager(*scene*)
:   Bases: `Generic`[[`SceneT`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.html#manim.manager.SceneT "manim.manager.SceneT")]

    Coordinate the render lifecycle for a single scene.

    A manager is attached to exactly one [`Scene`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.scene.scene.Scene.html#manim.scene.scene.Scene "manim.scene.scene.Scene"). It
    coordinates the scene lifecycle, delegates animation playback to the current
    renderer, and routes section, subcaption, and audio operations to the current
    file writer. Calling [`render()`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.scene.scene.Scene.html#manim.scene.scene.Scene.render "manim.scene.scene.Scene.render") creates a manager
    lazily when one has not already been attached.

    Parameters:
    :   **scene** ([*SceneT*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.html#manim.manager.SceneT "manim.manager.SceneT")) – The scene coordinated by this manager. A scene that already has a manager
        cannot be attached to another one.

    scene
    :   The managed scene.

    Notes

    This class is the coordination boundary for an incremental render-flow
    refactor. Renderer, camera, clock, and output ownership still remain on the
    scene and renderer for compatibility. The [`renderer`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.Manager.html#manim.manager.Manager.renderer "manim.manager.Manager.renderer"), [`camera`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.Manager.html#manim.manager.Manager.camera "manim.manager.Manager.camera"),
    [`file_writer`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.Manager.html#manim.manager.Manager.file_writer "manim.manager.Manager.file_writer"), [`time`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.Manager.html#manim.manager.Manager.time "manim.manager.Manager.time"), [`num_plays`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.Manager.html#manim.manager.Manager.num_plays "manim.manager.Manager.num_plays"), and
    [`skip_animations`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.Manager.html#manim.manager.Manager.skip_animations "manim.manager.Manager.skip_animations") properties are forwarding views for now.

    Examples

    A scene normally creates its manager when [`render()`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.scene.scene.Scene.html#manim.scene.scene.Scene.render "manim.scene.scene.Scene.render")
    is called. It can also be attached explicitly:

    ```
    scene = Scene()
    manager = Manager(scene)
    manager.render()
    ```

    add\_sound(*sound\_file*, *time\_offset=0*, *gain=None*, *\*\*kwargs*)
    :   Add sound to the output at the current scene time.

        No sound is added while animations are being skipped.

        Parameters:
        :   - **sound\_file** (*str*) – The path to the sound file.
            - **time\_offset** (*float*) – The offset in seconds from the current scene time.
            - **gain** (*float* *|* *None*) – The gain adjustment applied to the sound.
            - **kwargs** (*Any*) – Additional arguments forwarded to
              [`add_sound()`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.scene.scene_file_writer.SceneFileWriter.html#manim.scene.scene_file_writer.SceneFileWriter.add_sound "manim.scene.scene_file_writer.SceneFileWriter.add_sound").

        Return type:
        :   None

            - **duration** (*float*) – The duration in seconds for which the subcaption is displayed.
            - **offset** (*float*) – The offset in seconds from the current scene time.

    post\_construct()
    :   Finalize output after scene construction and tear-down.

        This validates empty video output, asks the renderer to finish the scene,
        and logs the number of played animations. It intentionally runs after
        [`tear_down()`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.Manager.html#manim.manager.Manager.tear_down "manim.manager.Manager.tear_down") to preserve the established render lifecycle.

        Return type:
        :   None

    render(*preview=False*)
    :   Run the complete render lifecycle for the managed scene.

        The lifecycle invokes [`setup()`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.Manager.html#manim.manager.Manager.setup "manim.manager.Manager.setup"), [`construct()`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.Manager.html#manim.manager.Manager.construct "manim.manager.Manager.construct"),
        [`tear_down()`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.Manager.html#manim.manager.Manager.tear_down "manim.manager.Manager.tear_down"), and [`post_construct()`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.manager.Manager.html#manim.manager.Manager.post_construct "manim.manager.Manager.post_construct"), in that order. Reaching a
        configured animation boundary ends construction normally. Exceptions
        raised while constructing the scene abort active encoding jobs before
        they are propagated.

        Parameters:
        :   **preview** (*bool*) – Whether the rendered media should be opened after rendering.

        Returns:
        :   `True` when an interactive rerun was requested; otherwise
            `False`. This matches the return value of
            [`render()`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.scene.scene.Scene.html#manim.scene.scene.Scene.render "manim.scene.scene.Scene.render").

        Return type:
        :   bool
